effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] By trashing 1 card with [Vemmon] in its text from your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have [Vemmon] in their texts, by suspending this Tamer, reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Place all [Vemmon] among them as any of those Digimon's bottom digivolution cards. Trash the rest.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
